financing.external_basis: The first $100k band is assumed consumed by other USD shorts. A minimum $100k external balance is used; unknown higher account tiers could increase the marginal credit.
financing.basis: Current published rates applied throughout as a financing sensitivity, not historical paid interest. Other USD shorts consume the first $100k band; other cash credit/debit interest is excluded.

differences: The earlier $50k account uses event-specific continuous quotes, displayed-book sizing, trading-status checks and entry-margin limits. Its 115 accepted trades have lower average spread/depth costs than the broad event population.

This illustration uses opening/closing auction price benchmarks, fixed starting-$10m ticket sizes, an aggregate spread/depth sensitivity and optional prior-volume caps. It does not replay the earlier account's fills or admission decisions.
Rescaling the same historical cash P&L to $10m preserves dollars and trades. Increasing orders to $25k-$100k requires a new fill/capacity test and cannot be obtained by multiplying the old CAGR.
RSI-2/RSI-3 use different decision clocks and stricter net-edge filters. Zero admitted trades in their primary policies is not evidence of executable alpha at the new ticket sizes.

method.sizing: Fixed dollars equal to the selected fraction of starting total portfolio NAV; no reinvestment or core-portfolio return assumed.
method.admissions: Known-before-entry, observed SSR-unrestricted cohort; three concurrent issuers, whole shares, $100 minimum. Borrow is assumed available.
method.capacity: Capacity-aware sizing caps shares at 0.1% of prior 20-session verified venue ADV. Partial target sizing is not proof of a broker fill. Target-size mode removes that cap and is a hypothetical capacity upper bound.
method.execution: Broad-cohort listing-venue quote half-spread quartiles plus a $500-reference full-population mean depth cost. This mixed-sample sensitivity is not the prior account's event-specific execution model, an auction fill model, consolidated NBBO, or evidence of costs at $25k-$100k. Commissions are separate.
method.borrow: Current indicative fee percentiles for quoted reverse-split names, applied as explicit historical sensitivities. Rounded 102% collateral, actual settlement calendar, T+2/T+1 and weekend accrual. Not historical invoices or approved locates.
method.proceeds_interest: IBKR Pro USD short-credit tiers are applied once per account to settled rounded short collateral, including weekends until cover settlement. The first $100k earns zero. Current 2026-10-19 rates are held fixed as a sensitivity; historical IBKR rates are not reconstructed. The first $100k band is assumed used by other shorts; a minimum external collateral balance of $100k gives a conservative marginal credit. Trade statistics exclude this account-level credit.
method.cash_funding: Short-credit income is separate from borrow fees. Other long-cash interest, collateral top-up funding costs and core-account debit interest are excluded because settled account cash and financing history are unavailable. Net results are conditional on that funding assumption, not Michael's actual all-in IBKR financing.
method.marks: Daily official closing-auction marks; missing marks carry the last observed liability and are counted. A missing cover waits for an observed close, never a zero-price exit.
method.margin: Hypothetical 100% house floor plus FINRA per-share maintenance floors. Collateral is rounded 102% of current market value. Collateral and equity margin are separate views of financing, not amounts to add together.
method.monte_carlo: 2,000 five-year paths resample complete historical calendar-month blocks, jointly retaining daily net P&L, margin and collateral, including idle sessions. Fixed starting-NAV position sizing. Conditional resampling, not a forecast or a simulation of unseen squeezes.
method.core_portfolio: All growth and risk statistics describe the incremental short sleeve against total starting NAV with the core portfolio held flat. Combined Michael-portfolio CAGR, covariance, drawdown and actual excess liquidity are unavailable without his daily portfolio and broker margin history.
method.exits: Fixed holding-period exits; no guaranteed stop-loss or profit-taking fill is assumed.
